title: Output Contract + Error Infrastructure + Global Settings
description: Implement the JSON output contract, the IOutputWriter abstraction, ZapiCliException, GlobalSettings, and the Spectre.Console CommandApp with its global exception handler. This establishes the complete I/O skeleton that every subsequent command will depend on.
prerequisiteState: Story 1 complete. Three projects compile. IKeychainProvider and all implementations exist. Program.cs stub exists.
goal: Produce a functional zapi-cli binary that correctly routes all output through IOutputWriter, converts exceptions to the JSON error envelope on stderr, and handles --help and --version with the correct exit codes.
scope: Add Spectre.Console.Cli NuGet reference to ZapiCli.csproj
Add Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection to ZapiCli.csproj and ZapiCli.Core.csproj
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/IOutputWriter.cs with WriteSuccess(object data) and WriteError(string message, string code, int exitCode)

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/JsonOutputWriter.cs implementing IOutputWriter — writes { "status": "ok", "data": ... } to stdout and { "error": ..., "code": ..., "exitCode": ... } to stderr using System.Text.Json with SnakeCaseLower naming policy
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/InMemoryOutputWriter.cs for tests — captures written output in List<string> properties for assertion
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/ZapiCliException.cs with string Code and int ExitCode properties

Create src/ZapiCli.Core/ErrorCodes.cs with all symbolic constants: ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, AUTH_FAILURE, NEEDS_REAUTH, HOST_NOT_ALLOWED, INVALID_ARGS, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, SCOPE_NOT_FOUND, REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, API_ERROR, NOT_IMPLEMENTED
Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/GlobalSettings.cs inheriting CommandSettings with --account, --json (default true), --no-input properties

Update src/ZapiCli/Program.cs: create IServiceCollection, register JsonOutputWriter as IOutputWriter singleton, register IKeychainProvider via KeychainProviderFactory, build CommandApp with ITypeRegistrar bridging MEDI, wire SetExceptionHandler to convert ZapiCliException and unhandled Exception to JSON error envelope on stderr
Create src/ZapiCli/DependencyInjectionRegistrar.cs to bridge Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection with Spectre.Console.Cli's ITypeRegistrar
Ensure Ctrl+C (CancellationTokenSource) triggers exit code 1 with no output
Write unit tests verifying: WriteSuccess produces correct JSON on stdout; WriteError produces correct envelope on stderr; ZapiCliException is correctly serialized by the global exception handler
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
zapi-cli --version prints the version and exits 0
zapi-cli --help prints top-level help and exits 0
An unhandled ZapiCliException produces { "error": "...", "code": "...", "exitCode": 1 } on stderr and exits with the code's exit code
An unhandled generic Exception produces { "error": "...", "code": "INTERNAL_ERROR", "exitCode": 1 } on stderr
IOutputWriter is registered in DI and injected into command classes via constructor
JsonOutputWriter uses JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower for all serialized output
InMemoryOutputWriter is available in ZapiCli.Tests for use by all future test stories
Token values do not appear in any output path (verified by code inspection — no Console.Write outside IOutputWriter)
All eight symbolic error codes are defined in ErrorCodes.cs as static readonly string constants
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0001 for the .NET 10 / C# 13 build requirements. The error envelope has an optional 'detail' field for API_ERROR only (see OQ-007). The --no-input flag defaults to false but is recommended to always be passed by agents — any code path that would prompt for interactive input must instead exit 1 with a structured JSON error when this flag is set. All command settings classes must inherit GlobalSettings. Use DependencyInjectionRegistrar to bridge MEDI with Spectre.Console.Cli.

openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-007. Only API_ERROR uses 'detail'. All other error codes omit it. JsonOutputWriter should support an optional detail parameter on WriteError.
Add Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console registered at Warning level by default. Log to stderr only. Do not emit log lines that could break the JSON output contract on stdout.

sourceReferences: tech_spec/prd.md (§ FR-008 JSON output contract, § FR-009 non-interactive mode)
